title: prompt-engineering
universal_lens: The generative prompt space is a high-dimensional manifold where sensory constraints act as Dirac delta potentials, collapsing the latent wavefunction. Image-to-image and video transitions represent unitary operators acting on this state vector, strictly enforcing differential transformations over redundant static descriptions to minimize entropy.
gsi_mapping: In GSI, concrete sensory prompts function as strong priors in a Bayesian hierarchical model, sharply reducing posterior variance for event outcomes. The strict avoidance of redescribing known inputs mirrors conformal inference, ensuring predictive intervals rely solely on novel, orthogonal feature shifts rather than collinear historical noise.
gse_mapping: GSE treats `--start-image` as an initial boundary condition $S_0$. Prompts define the Hamiltonian flow (e.g., 'dollies left', 'spins') governing the Markovian state transition to $S_t$. Redundant static descriptions introduce singularities in the velocity field, causing trajectory collapse or hallucinatory drift.

primitives.verbatim_quote: - Verbs: zooms in, dollies left, sweeping pan, slow push, fast whip - Subject motion: "the dancer spins", "smoke rises slowly" - Don't redescribe the static frame — model already has it.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Time $t$: seconds; Camera/Subject velocity $v(t)$: pixels/frame or degrees/frame.
primitives.assumptions: Video generation operates as a continuous-time dynamical system driven by discrete linguistic velocity vectors.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Conflicting kinematic verbs (e.g., simultaneous opposing pans) create non-integrable pathologies in the temporal diffusion process.

layer2.mapping: Directly maps to defining the drift coefficient in a Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE) for tracking athlete or object trajectories.
layer2.telemetry: Optical flow consistency and frame-to-frame correlation metrics.

The provided excerpts delineate a rigorous mathematical framework for navigating high-dimensional generative manifolds. We begin with the foundational operator: the Concrete Sensory Collapse. In any probabilistic generative system, the prior distribution is vast and ambiguous. By injecting concrete, sensory details (subject, setting, lighting), we apply a series of constraint functions that drastically reduce the volume of the viable latent space, effectively collapsing the wavefunction into a coherent, high-fidelity representation. This is mathematically analogous to solving a partial differential equation by imposing strict Dirichlet boundary conditions.

From this static equilibrium, we derive the Differential Transform Kernel. When transitioning states (image-to-image), the system already possesses a complete encoding of the current state $S_0$. Re-specifying $S_0$ via text introduces redundant, potentially noisy constraints that conflict with the visual encoder's precise embedding. The optimal operator acts purely on the difference vector $\Delta S$, applying a unitary transformation (e.g., style transfer) while preserving the underlying topological invariants of the subject. This ensures energy conservation within the semantic manifold.

Finally, the Temporal Velocity Field extends these concepts into the time domain. Video generation is modeled as a continuous dynamical system. The `--start-image` provides the initial condition, while the prompt supplies the vector field—comprising camera kinematics (pans, dollies) and subject dynamics (spinning, rising). The critical failure mode identified across all primitives is 'collinearity leakage': attempting to re-define known states (redescribing the static frame) when the system only requires the derivative or the orthogonal transformation. This redundancy causes gradient interference, leading to hallucinatory distortions or kinetic breakdowns in the generated sequence.

reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: We must model the generative AI not as a passive canvas, but as an active, adversarial agent attempting to maximize likelihood under severe ambiguity. The human prompter acts as a regulator, supplying minimal yet sufficient constraints. If the prompter fails to distinguish between state description and state transition, the AI's internal attention mechanisms collide, interpreting redundant text as conflicting instructions, ultimately resulting in a breakdown of the synthesized reality.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: A strict veto condition must be applied to any prompt exhibiting high collinearity with the encoded visual input. If the textual embedding vector is nearly parallel to the image embedding vector, the operation is flagged as a redundant static description and rejected. Only orthogonal vectors—representing pure stylistic shifts or temporal derivatives—are permitted to propagate through the diffusion layers, preventing catastrophic interference and maintaining manifold integrity.
